name: What is the process for ordering custom cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for ordering custom cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. Next, our design team will create detailed drawings and material selections. Once approved, we move to fabrication, where your cabinets are meticulously built. The final step is professional installation in your home, ensuring a perfect fit and finish. We maintain open communication with you throughout each phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: The custom cabinet ordering process involves an initial consultation, design and material selection, fabrication, and finally professional installation.
